subject: Recap + next steps: prompt collection & model-fit for ACME pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Jill Torres <jill.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Recap + next steps: prompt collection & model-fit for ACME pilot

Hi Samir / Jill 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and clear asks so we can start model-fit evals for the pilot: 

1) Summary of what we heard
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + triage for billing/tech issues (short summaries + classification).
- Volume: ~1.2M messages/month; 95th pct size ~1-2KB per ticket.
- SLO: sub-300ms median token latency for front-line triage UI, and high recall on safety-critical classes.

2) Redwood initial recommendations (model & eval plan)
- Models to benchmark: redwood-3.2-13b-quant (good balance of quality/cost), redwood-7b-llama-quant (lower cost baseline), and an open baseline (e.g., meta-2.7b) for comparison.
- Metrics: ROUGE/similarity for summarization, precision/recall for triage labels, and human-rated quality pass/fail on a small eval set.
- Acceptance criteria: we propose >0.85 macro recall on P0/P1 classes and MTurk-rated average quality >=4/5 for summaries. We can iterate thresholds once we see your sample prompts.

3) What we need from ACME (asks)
- Please fill the attached prompt collection template (acme_prompt_collection_template.csv) with: representative user prompts, edge cases, expected outputs (when possible), and redaction guidance per field.
- Include 20-50 concrete examples across the most common intents and 10-15 edge cases (PII, truncated messages, multi-turn).
- If you have existing labels for triage, include a sample mapping CSV.

4) Security & redaction guidance
- Please flag fields that must be redacted before sharing (PII / billing info). See attached redaction_guidelines.pdf for recommended patterns. If you cannot share raw PII, fill the template and replace values with <REDACTED> and keep labels intact.

5) Next steps / timeline
- You: share completed template and sample labels by Mon, 2026-03-29.
- Us: run initial evals and share benchmark links + a short quality regression note by Fri, 2026-04-02.
- Optional: 30-min walkthrough of the template  happy to schedule this week if useful.

Attachments: acme_prompt_collection_template.csv (template), redaction_guidelines.pdf (guide)

Links: https://drive.google.com/benchmarking/redwood-vs-open-models-acme (benchmark plan), https://app.redwood.com/evals/acme-ACME-142 (eval dashboard - internal)

Thanks  looking forward to the prompt set.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Jill Torres <jill.torres@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: prompt collection & model-fit for ACME pilot

Thanks Marissa  this is great and super clear. Quick Qs from our side: 

1) For redaction, is it OK if we replace PII with consistent tokens (e.g., <EMAIL>, <SSN>) or do you prefer complete <REDACTED> placeholders?
2) Do you have a recommended sample size breakdown by intent? We can do 50 happy-path + 20 edge cases per intent if that helps.

We’ll start populating the template. Can you also confirm whether the eval dashboard link will be accessible to Acme reviewers or only internal to Redwood?

On Mon, Mar 22, 2026 at 10:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com> wrote:
> (See message below)

Samir

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Recap + next steps: prompt collection & model-fit for ACME pilot

Marissa / Marcus 

Couple of internal notes to align before we ingest any samples: 

- Model choices: I agree with redwood-3.2-13b-quant as primary eval. Also recommend adding a quantized 7b baseline and a low-latency distilled variant if we need to validate sub-200ms token latency for a front-line UI.
- Benchmarks: we should include a small human eval (10-15 raters) for safety-critical classes to detect quality regressions early.
- Redaction guidance (to provide to Acme): recommend consistent tokenization (<EMAIL>, <PHONE>, <CARD>) so that we can run differential analysis on masked vs unmasked inputs. If they insist on full redaction, require an anonymization map kept locally at ACME so labels remain credible.
- Deliverables: I'll prepare a short checklist for ingestion (file format, encoding, label mapping) and a suggested acceptance criteria doc we can share with Samir.

I’ll drop that checklist into the shared Drive link and ping you both when ready.

Neha

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.com>, Jill Torres <jill.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap + next steps: prompt collection & model-fit for ACME pilot

Samir 

Great questions. Short answers: 
- Redaction: consistent tokens like <EMAIL>/<PHONE> are preferred (we can support <REDACTED> but tokens help us run differential evals). If you use tokens, please keep a private mapping locally in case we need to re-evaluate.
- Sample breakdown: that 50 happy-path + 20 edge-cases per intent is perfect; for intents with lower volume we can accept fewer examples but prioritize variety.
- Eval dashboard access: we will share a read-only link to the eval dashboard for ACME reviewers once initial runs complete.

I’ve attached the template and the redaction guide again and added the checklist Neha prepared to the Drive link. If you can aim to return the completed template by Mon, 2026-03-29 we’ll run the first batch that week and share results by Fri, 2026-04-02.

If helpful I can book 30 minutes this Thursday to walk through the template with your team  propose Thu 2026-03-25 11:00-11:30 PT. Confirm if that works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks 
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: acme_prompt_collection_template.csv, redaction_guidelines.pdf
snippet: Recap + next steps: prompt collection template attached; prefer token redaction; send samples by 2026-03-29.
